introducer.title: github: migrate GitHub repository filesystem to shared API

cases.mechanism: The old readdir implementation scanned the complete recursive entries Map and tested/sliced every path for each directory listing, making browsing D directories in an N-entry repository O(D*N).
cases.symptom: Expanding directories in large github-remote-file repositories repeatedly rescanned the full tree, increasing directory-open latency and CPU with both repository size and the number of directories visited.
cases.fixedBehavior: The PR builds a parent-to-direct-children index once per fetched tree and changes readdir to a direct lookup/copy, reducing repeated listings to O(number of returned children) after the O(N) index build.
cases.evidence: Base line 229 is the loop over all tree.entries inside readdir, introduced by the blamed commit. Added line 241 returns only tree.children.get(path); the new index is constructed once when the already-recursive tree is fetched and shared by subsequent readdir calls.
